description: Look up an ISBN on Open Library and return the edition details plus the other editions of the same book. Inputs: isbn (10 or 13 digits, hyphens allowed). The check digit is tested first, so a typo is reported before any search. The reply has the title, authors, publisher, publish date, page count and edition name, and says whether a free copy is known. Related editions are listed newest first. Example prompt: "Look up ISBN 978-0-13-468599-1 and tell me what other editions exist."

isbn.description: The ISBN to look up, 10 or 13 digits, hyphens and spaces allowed.
